summary.text: Customers find this pet feeder well-made and USA-made, with positive feedback about its durability and ease of cleaning, particularly noting it washes in the dishwasher without warping. The product effectively slows down eating speed, with one customer mentioning it helps with digestion, and customers appreciate its bigger-than-expected size that holds a decent amount of food. They like its engagement value, with one customer noting it keeps their pet busy for hours, and find it works well for both big and small dogs.
